notes.title: Post-Release Content Drop!
notes.content:
[h2][i][b]Tower of the Ice Lich [/b][/i]has already been out over a month – and we couldn’t be more grateful for all the feedback, bug reports and ideas you’ve shared with us![/h2]

As a way to say thank you and keep the adventure going we have prepared a content drop for you!

[u][b]What's New:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Two new questlines along with some individual room reworks
[*] Know Your Shrooms 
[*] Boon of the All-Father 
[*] 10 new achievements
[*] 3 new items
[*] 1 new enemy
[/list]

We hope you’ll enjoy diving into the new content – and as always, we’d love to hear what you think. Your feedback helps shape the Adventure.

Arcane Lorelabs
